verdict.rationale: Codegen documents that its agent can review PRs and suggest changes. A codegen.com workflow describes reading the PR diff and posting a review comment, and the API references PR 'checks' run by agents. However, the evidence does not clearly show a setting that reviews every PR automatically, and it never mentions line-level inline comments. Documented review examples are on-demand (an SDK prompt such as 'Leave a review on PR #123'). missing for 10: documented automatic trigger on every PR, inline line-level review comments, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have every pull request automatically reviewed with AI-generated inline comments
